ruleDefinitions.name: Local Groups Discovery - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects enumeration of local system groups. Adversaries may attempt to find local system groups and permission settings

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/groups$") OR ((process_path = RGX("\\/cat$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ed$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/head$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/less$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/more$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/nano$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/tail$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/vi$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/vim$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/group.*")))
